text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: DIVPE/LND/ACQUI/5/2/1. Land Ministry's Ref No.: 4-3/18/2019/WS/485. I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for the construction of a 2000 cubic meter underground reservoir at Rambawewa and a 450 cubic meter water tower for the proposed Katupotha - Bamunakotuwa - Panduwasnuwara Water Supply Project. Description of the land/servitude to be acquired: Land depeicted in the Sheet No. 1 Block No. 02 of the Cadastral Map No. 420849 of prepared by the Senior Superintendent of Surveys-Kurunegala, situated in the Village called Paathamulla in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 1362 of Gallehepitiya in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Panduwasnuwara East in Kurunegala District of the North Western Province and described as follows: 01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Dangahamulahena; Current use of the land: Estate; Claimant: Government; First Owner:

Mr. Wijesingha Aarachchilage Sunil Wijesingha, Ranaviru Pradeep Mawatha, Paathamulla, Kanaththewewa; Extent: 0.2018 Hectare. (1rood 39.8 perches) 02. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: --; Current use of the land: Estate; Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0005 Hectare (0.2 perches). All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Panduwasnuwara East Divisional Secretariat on 20th of August in 2025 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 20th of August in 13th of August in 2025 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. G. P. S. J. Dൾ Zඈඒඌൺ, Divisional Secretary, Panduwasnuwara East. On the 05th day of June 2025, At Divisional Secretariat - Panduwasnuwara East. EOG 06 - 0140
